section_16_ia.text:
Section 15-17: Gross Salary Income. Standard deduction applied automatically.
• Old Regime: ₹50,000 standard deduction. Exemptions like HRA, LTA, and Professional Tax are applicable.
• New Regime: ₹75,000 standard deduction. HRA, LTA, and Professional Tax exemptions are NOT applicable.

section_80tta.text:
Section 80TTA: Exemption on savings interest for individuals/HUFs (non-seniors).
• Old Regime: Exemption up to ₹10,000.
• New Regime: No exemption allowed (fully taxable).

section_80ttb.text:
Section 80TTB: Exemption on savings and FD interest for senior citizens.
• Old Regime: Exemption up to ₹50,000.
• New Regime: No exemption allowed (fully taxable).

section_44ada.text: Section 44ADA: Presumptive taxation for professionals. Taxable profit is flat 50% of gross receipts. Max limit: ₹75 Lakhs.

section_44ad.text: Section 44AD: Presumptive taxation for businesses. Taxable profit is flat 6% of digital turnover (or 8% for cash). Max limit: ₹3 Crores.

misc_income.text:
Income from other sources (Rent, Freelance, Family Pension). Rental Income gets a flat 30% deduction (Sec 24a).
• Old Regime: Family Pension std deduction (Sec 57iia) is ₹15,000. Home Loan Interest (Sec 24b) on self-occupied house allowed up to ₹2 Lakhs.
• New Regime: Family Pension std deduction is ₹25,000. Home Loan Interest on self-occupied house is NOT allowed.

other_interest.text: Interest from Bonds, PPF maturity, NSC, etc. PPF interest is fully exempt (Sec 10(11)). Bonds/NCDs are taxable at slab rates.

dividend.text: Dividends are fully taxable at applicable slab rates. No deductions allowed. TDS is deducted at 10% under Section 194 if dividend exceeds ₹5,000.

foreign_interest.text: Taxable at slab rates. To be declared in Schedule FSI/FA. Double Taxation Relief (DTAA) under Section 90/90A may be claimed if tax was withheld abroad.

crypto_vda.text: Section 115BBH: Taxed at flat 30%. No basic exemption limit. No deductions allowed except cost of acquisition. Losses from crypto cannot be set off against any other income.

gaming_lottery.text: Section 115BB: Winnings from Lotteries, Game Shows, and Online Games. Taxed at flat 30%. TDS is deducted at 30% under Sec 194BA/194BB. No deductions allowed.
